newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Int'l Bank of Asia ups FRCD to HK$575mln.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Bank of Asia ups FRCD to HK$575mln.

text.p: International Bank of Asia's floating rate certificate of deposit issue was increased to HK$575 million from HK$500 million due to oversubscription, arrangers said on Wednesday.
The three-year facility was priced at par to float at 50 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 79 basis points.
Arrangers and lead managers with HK$70 million each, are Commerz East Asia, Dresdner SEA, Sakura Finance Asia and Westpac Banking Corp, Hong Kong.
Co-lead managers, with HK$50 million, each are Nomura International Hong Kong and Peregrine Fixed Income.
Manager Hong Kong Chinese Bank and Bank of Hawaii Hong Kong, committed HK$40 million and HK$30 million respectively.

Other managers, with HK$25 million each, are BW Bank Ireland, Banco Central Hispanoamericano S.A., Banco Espirito Santo do Oriente S.A.R.L., Berliner Bank Aktiengesellschaft, and Industrial and Commercial Bank of China.
